title: Pakistan: common provincial and municipal building by-laws
publisher: Provincial development authorities (LDA, CDA, SBCA, RDA, PDA)
disclaimer: READ THIS BEFORE USING ANY FINDING FROM THIS PACK. Pakistan has no single national code for room sizes, setbacks or coverage. Those are set by the development authority for each city, and they differ by scheme, by plot category and by plot size within the same city. The values here are figures that recur across LDA, CDA and SBCA residential by-laws; they are a starting point for a conversation with the authority, NOT a statement of what applies to any particular plot. Every finding from this pack must be confirmed against the by-laws for the specific scheme before it is relied on. The Building Code of Pakistan 2021 covers seismic design and 2016 covers fire safety; neither is encoded here.

site.$comment: Indicative planning controls, keyed by city. Confirm every one against the authority for the scheme.

rules.title: Habitable room area
rules.message: {name} is {area_m2} m²; by-laws commonly set 9.29 m² (100 sq ft) for a habitable room.
rules.note: Confirm against the authority for the scheme; this figure varies.

rules.title: Habitable room least width
rules.message: {name} is {width_mm} mm across; 2440 mm (8 ft) is a common minimum.

rules.title: Kitchen area
rules.message: {name} is {area_m2} m²; 4.65 m² (50 sq ft) is a common minimum for a kitchen.

rules.title: Bathroom area
rules.message: {name} is {area_m2} m²; 2.79 m² (30 sq ft) is a common minimum.

rules.title: Clear ceiling height
rules.message: {name} has about {clear_height_mm} mm clear; 2750 mm (9 ft) is commonly required, and some schemes ask 3050 mm.

rules.title: Staircase width
rules.message: The stair is {width_mm} mm wide; 900 mm is a common residential minimum.

rules.title: Riser height
rules.message: The riser is {riser_mm} mm; 190 mm is a common cap.

rules.title: Tread depth
rules.message: The tread is {going_mm} mm; 250 mm is a common minimum.

rules.title: Ground coverage
rules.message: Ground coverage is {coverage_ratio} of the plot; 0.65 is a common residential cap, and Islamabad is often lower.
rules.note: Coverage, FAR and setbacks are the provisions that vary most between authorities and schemes. Treat this as a prompt to check, not an answer.

rules.title: Floor area ratio
rules.message: The floor area ratio is {floor_area_ratio}; 1.6 is an indicative residential cap.
